decisions.title: Close Gate 0 for a governed provider executor

effective_grants.basis: Adversarial path prevention and the active binary autoload surface remain incomplete.
Public egress and DNS behavior are not measured.

conditions: T0.9, T0.10 and T0.11 must be resolved for the exact provider digest and configuration.
Unknown never becomes allow and no model may waive a dependency.

dependencies.note: Claude schema behavior was observed, but the final provider-facing schema was not rerun.
Host fixture process termination passed; provider transfer and graceful interruption remain unmeasured.
Host fixture environment and output passed; same-user credential stores remain outside the claim.
Detection exists, but the race escaped and symbolic link behavior is unknown.
Autoload evidence belongs to the historical Codex digest.
Crash recovery and unknown effects are not measured.
Permission probe usage is absent and real monetary cost is unknown.

decisions.title: Permit the deterministic first slice without provider writes
scope_allowed: Deterministic implementation and tests for init, doctor and status
Read-only provider judgment over the reviewed first-party repository with no mutable tools
scope_excluded: Any APF runtime execution of a provider
Any provider tool with external effects

effective_grants.basis: Provider mutation is denied; read-only review is a development aid outside the APF runtime.
Read-only reviewers receive no command or code execution tools.
Provider tool network access is not measured; inference destination is disclosed separately.

conditions: The first slice contains no provider adapter, execution broker or mutable provider tool.
Brain, backups and secrets stay outside agent-writable workspaces.
A provider digest change invalidates its read-only claim.
T0.8b must be issued before Slice 2 begins.

dependencies.note: Sufficient for local deterministic process supervision design, not provider execution.
Sufficient for implementing bounded local diagnostics, not secrets containment.
No APF runtime provider execution exists in Slice 1; read-only development review uses explicit safe mode and no mutable tools.
Slice 1 does not meter provider execution; review cost remains estimated list basis and actual spend unknown.

unknowns: Read-only provider behavior is provider-enforced rather than independent host containment.
The active Codex autoload case is not measured.

decisions.title: Permit provider writes in the owner repository

effective_grants.basis: An ordinary file boundary passed once, but adversarial path prevention remains unknown and the race escaped in the host fixture.
Public egress and DNS are not measured.
No destructive provider action is eligible while the decision is incomplete.

conditions: A repeated positive control alone is insufficient; provider-native adversarial path behavior must be measured.
Crash recovery must prove interrupted state and no silent retry.
Usage and cost normalization must persist source, confidence and cost basis.

dependencies.note: Detection only; the race escaped and symbolic link behavior is unknown.
The active Codex digest has no autoload conformance evidence.
Usage was absent from the permission probe and actual monetary cost is unknown.

decisions.title: Handle hostile repositories and unknown content
scope_excluded: Any host execution against a hostile or unreviewed repository
Any package or hook execution from hostile content
Any human override that claims containment

effective_grants.basis: No isolated execution surface is measured.
Container or virtual machine containment is required but not evaluated.
Install scripts from hostile content are never executed on the host.

conditions: The required container or virtual machine must itself be measured before it creates an execution path.
Until then, hostile content is refused rather than run under advisory controls.

dependencies.note: Host path prevention is not sufficient for hostile content.
No provider or container egress boundary is measured.

unknowns: Container or virtual machine efficacy and availability

invalidation_triggers.statement: Any sandbox, approval, autoload or Windows backend configuration change.
Any operating system build, account privilege or execution account change.
Any classifier logic change after the correction recorded as DEF-01.
Any referenced raw evidence digest mismatch.

unknown_policy: UNKNOWN, NOT_EVALUATED and incomplete dependencies always resolve to DENY; neither a model nor a human override changes the recorded enforcement level.
non_claims: Gate 0 is not closed as a whole.
Approval of Slice 1 is not approval of a provider execution slice.
No decision claims independent host containment of a provider process.
A container requirement does not mean a container baseline exists.
The raw classifier defect was not erased and no model call was repeated.
